description: This file defines the DatabaseServerConnection class, which manages the singleton database connection for the installer component of the OrangeHRM HRM system. It establishes a connection using Doctrine DBAL and handles connection initialization and reset.

classes.name: DatabaseServerConnection
classes.description: Handles the creation, retrieval, and reset of a singleton database connection using Doctrine DBAL during system installation.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the singleton database connection, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the singleton database connection to null.
